resolved_conflicts.field: events: original tower date and height
resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts date a 67-foot pole tower with an L-6 cab to 1933; the 1962 Potlatch report, as quoted on Forest Lookouts, says the CCC built a 90-foot wood tower in 1934. The record height of 20.4 m matches the 67-foot figure.
The 1962 Potlatch report says a war-surplus steel tower replaced the old one in 1962; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1963 and an 86-foot steel tower.

notes_for_editor: Two sources disagree on the tower's height (67 vs 90 feet), its build year (1933 vs 1934) and the replacement year (1962 vs 1963); the story reports both. Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site 'Drive-Up Removed', which is not explained, so no visit facts are recorded. No source describes what remains at the site or its public access, so no access key is included. Staff names come from a 1950 and a 1980 listing and a 1952 newspaper item.
